Recent exam packs and past paper bundles

The recent exam layer tracks 22 subject-session combinations after deduplication. The 11 strongest complete sessions are now available across five subject packs; QA-required and incomplete sessions stay out until their answer mapping is resolved.

Choose a recent exam pack by subject

Each pack counts one canonical version per exam session and excludes alternate scans. These five packs are available through direct Creem checkout with protected ZIP delivery after payment.

CSCA Math Recent Exam Pack

Four complete 2026 mathematics sessions with canonical papers, answer keys, and detailed explanations for timed review and mistake analysis.
View pack and price →
CSCA Physics Recent Exam Pack

Two complete 2026 physics sessions with bilingual papers, answer keys, and detailed explanations for engineering and STEM routes.
View pack and price →
CSCA Chemistry Recent Exam Pack

Two complete chemistry sessions with canonical papers, answer keys, and detailed explanations for medicine and science preparation.
View pack and price →
Humanities Chinese Recent Exam Pack

Two complete 2026 Humanities Chinese sessions with clean papers, answer mappings, and explanation files for route-specific review.
View pack and price →
STEM Chinese Recent Exam Pack

One complete April 2026 STEM Chinese session with a clean paper, full 1-80 answer table, and detailed explanations.
View pack and price →

What is not inside these packs

Alternate scans and overlapping editions do not increase the advertised session count.

Five sessions with unverified answer mapping or known answer conflicts stay in the QA queue.

Six sessions with missing or partial answer keys remain on hold and are not presented as scoreable products.

Older reference and comparison bundles

These remain separate from the recent exam packs. Use them for historical paper context and university-by-university syllabus comparison, not as extra recent CSCA sessions.

CSCA Math Past Paper Reference Pack

A curated bundle of older university entrance math papers and syllabuses for historical reference around the CSCA math route.
View reference scope →
China University Entrance Syllabus Comparison Pack

A cross-school syllabus comparison bundle showing how universities structured entrance expectations before or alongside CSCA.
View reference scope →

A clearer path to CSCA subjects, exam logistics, technical readiness, and preparation planning for international students.
